swa_research.lesson.enrolled: Archivist lesson accepted. Open Force Practices in the holocron and examine the radio operator’s glove.
swa_research.lesson.requires_enrollment: Opt in at the archivist’s holocron to try the two gloves.
swa_research.lesson.requires_echo: Hear the echo in the radio operator’s glove.
swa_research.lesson.requires_observation: Complete Object Echo in the holocron.
swa_research.lesson.requires_both_gloves: Examine the radio operator’s glove and the identical spare before making your prediction.
swa_research.lesson.control_glove: The spare glove has the same fabric and lining. You sense no echo.
swa_research.lesson.historical_echo: Two knocks. Someone is holding another person upright.
swa_research.lesson.prediction.material: Prediction recorded. The metal token should stay silent if the glove’s material causes the echo.
swa_research.lesson.prediction.personal_: Prediction recorded. The metal token should carry an echo if the event left a trace.
swa_research.lesson.prediction_already_s: You have recorded a prediction. Test it on the signal officer’s token.
swa_research.lesson.needs_prediction: Record a prediction before examining the signal officer’s token.
swa_research.lesson.needs_comparison: Test your prediction on the signal officer’s token before finishing this page.
swa_research.lesson.token_echo: The cold metal carries a fragment of a voice. “Lean on me. We’ll make it.”
swa_research.lesson.contradicted: The metal token echoed and the spare glove stayed silent. The material hypothesis fails. Record a new prediction and try again.
swa_research.lesson.verified: Two different materials carry traces of the same event. Finish Testing the Evidence in the archivist’s holocron.
swa_research.lesson.theory_already_verif: Your result is already verified. Open the archivist’s holocron to review it.
swa_research.lesson.mastered: Psychometry learned. You can read the buckle on the crate by the loading ramp.
swa_research.lesson.buckle_locked: You can’t hold on to the impression. Finish Testing the Evidence in the holocron.
swa_research.lesson.buckle_echo: The clasp snaps shut. Someone hides a field kit behind the loading ramp.
